description: From the root revision, Tokenizer.decode_ removes EOS before testing for it and filters extended IDs outside the backend vocabulary before special rendering; both behaviors persist unchanged at commit 40fb78f.
trigger: Decode a sequence containing EOS followed by ordinary tokens, or request special rendering of a mapped extended ID at or above the backend vocabulary size.
expected_behavior: The explicit EOS truncation branch discards the suffix, and mapped extended tokens survive to special rendering.
actual_behavior: EOS is removed before the truncation test, so suffix tokens remain; the vocabulary-bound filter discards out-of-backend extended IDs before dictionary rendering.

introductions.scope: Both filtering orders are present in the root tree.

observations.source: Commit 31 authoring finding and independent Fable mailbox review.
observations.reach: decode_ is called by both rank-one and rank-two branches of public decode.
observations.limits: Broader generation workflows were not traced and no backend decode ran.

limits: No repository tokenizer, tensor code or backend decoding was executed.
A scalar list-filter transcription in the authoring run is not repository execution.

source.artifact: Root and commit-31 tokenizer decode source scan

impact.rationale: The source order defeats an explicit truncation branch and can discard wrapper-known tokens, but runtime reach beyond public decode was not inventoried.

administrative_review_status: Commit-31 inherited finding independently confirmed by Fable; ledger candidate awaits independent review.
